Harbor Street Family Practice REFERRAL LETTER February 8, 2060
To: Dr. Saeed Al-Rashidi, Gastroenterology, Merrimack Endoscopy Center From: Mateus Figueiredo, MD (primary care) Re: Ngozi Halvorsen DOB 05/03/2010 MRN 2290-6718 Patient name in the system: HALVORSEN, NGOZI. She ask us to use Eze from now, her maiden name, divorce is not finish. Please use both until the papers.
Dear Dr Al-Rashidi,
Thank you to see Mrs Halvorsen, a 49 years old woman for screening colonoscopy. She is first time for this. No bleeding, no change in the bowel, only some times constipation. The weight is stable since 2 years, BMI 30.6, and glycemic control borderline, HbA1c 6.0 today, glucose 80.
Family history: this is not clear. Father Chukwuemeka Eze, who is 91 years old now, had polyps, "maybe cancer" patient say. Her mother Adaeze is dead. When I asked again today she tell me the father is ninety and never had colonoscopy; in the last visit she said he have colon cancer at 61. I am not sure what is true, please ask the sister Ifeoma Eze (978) 555-0171 if she is agree. Grandmother "Mama Nkechi" is 93.
PMH: prediabetes, obesity, anemia (historical), miscarriage 2049, pre-eclampsia in the pregnancy 2058 (daughter Ada, 19 months), chronic pain since 2051, stress. Patient deny any surgery, but she has a C-section scar?? - delivery 07/28/2058 at emergency department, I think it was the vaginal. I did not examin. Meds: none now, IUD in place since 09/19/2058.
Allergies: patient say "no", <<allergy list>> not filled.
Social: she works at Corvid Analytics no more, home with the baby. Lives at 7 Wickersham Close, Lowell, MA 01852, but she mention maybe stay with sister. Insurance BCM 6618-402-17.
Please do colonoscopy and send report to me. Kind regard,
Mateus Figueiredo, MD Electronically signed 02/08/2060 17:11 cc: Hannah Prewitt RN; patient
